assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Equal right-to-sit principles and six seating prototypes are conceptual suggestions derived from the participant's design intent; quantities, dimensions, locations, management rules, and accessibility details require co-design, official geometry, footfall, fire-safety, operations, and accessibility review.
assumptions.impact: The concept may guide content review and later public-space design, but it is not an approved facility schedule, construction detail, social policy, or implementation commitment.

assumptions.statement: Underground low-speed unmanned logistics is an optional research direction, not a confirmed tunnel or road proposal.
assumptions.impact: No route, capacity, cost, feasibility, or implementation claim may be made before geotechnical, ownership, utilities, fire, flood, evacuation, energy, maintenance, and human-takeover review.

assumptions.statement: The Campus-City Commons Loop is a conceptual collaboration network; exact school boundaries, access rules, child protection, open hours, security, and shared facilities have not been supplied.
assumptions.impact: The proposal may suggest off-campus pilots and managed interfaces but cannot draw routes through campuses or promise campus opening.

assumptions.statement: The Grounded AI Rail pilgrimage landmarks are conceptual walkable and tactile installations derived from railway-to-AI history.
assumptions.impact: Detailed design requires heritage, accessibility, slip resistance, structural, lighting, acoustic, fire, maintenance, and public co-design review.
